title: Decoding paired chunks
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean tape alphabet, and let $ch$ be a finite list of pairs of Boolean symbols. Decode the list of first coordinates of $ch$ and the list of second coordinates of $ch$ separately into machine chunks; the resulting pair of optional cell values is the decoded paired chunk.
